title: WKAppBot Build and Entrypoint Incident 2026-08-10
desc: T3 dated incident record for the 2026-08-10 Codex session covering entrypoint split-brain fixes, Bash runtime failure, offline restore limits, and direct binary smoke evidence.
steps: SCOPE: This T3 record preserves the 2026-08-10 Codex work and must be read with wkappbot-build-verify-workflow, skill-contribute-edit, and knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa.@@INCIDENT: skill edit resolved a Project fork differently from skill read because the edit path applied an HQ higher-version override. Fix: return the Project fork directly when it exists, so read and edit share Project-first precedence.@@INCIDENT: skill install --id and suggest resolve used filename or ad hoc Project-to-HQ scans instead of loaded SkillRecord.Id and the shared resolver. Fix: match loaded record identity and route suggest resolve through FindSkill.@@VERIFIED: git commit a16146983 contains the three entrypoint fixes. Recheck with git show a16146983 and compare skill read, skill edit target resolution, skill install --id, and suggest resolve behavior.@@INCIDENT: C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe and sh.exe terminate with CreateFileMapping Win32 error 5 before the build script starts. This is a host runtime or permission failure, not a C# compile failure. Verify with bash.exe --version and a minimal bash invocation before diagnosing the build script.@@INCIDENT: dotnet restore reaches NU1301 for api.nuget.org in the restricted environment, while cached packages exist locally. Offline publish can only use existing project.assets.json files and still may fail in MSBuild project-reference target-framework expansion. Record this as an environment or toolchain limitation until a clean publish proves otherwise.@@VERIFIED: bin\\wktest-core-manual-v7.9.75.exe passed version, skill list, skill read, and skill search smoke commands. Direct staged-binary smoke proves the binary behavior only; it does not prove launcher publish, Bash health, or a full source rebuild.@@NEXT: repair or replace the Git Bash host runtime, then run the canonical root build and deployment smoke flow from AGENTS.md. Use wkappbot skill read wkappbot-build-verify-workflow before retrying and keep the staged binary separate until smoke passes.
